_naming_note: This is a dispatcher-configured loadout snapshot plus a vendor-CLI probe. It is NOT observed runtime behaviour. 'dispatcher' = what backends.json asks for. 'vendor_cli' = what the CLI itself offers. requested != observed. Past stale_after_days, lower recommendation confidence — never assume it is current.

economy._note: Economy availability is a PROPERTY OF THE PATH, not of the fleet. A single fleet-wide economy flag would be a false statement, because the DIRECT path does have lower tiers even though no delegate worker is pinned to one.
economy.delegate_economy_reason: Every worker in backends.json is pinned to a premium/frontier loadout (opus·max, gpt-5.6-sol·high, Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), grok-4.5·high). No worker is pinned to haiku, luna, or Flash.
economy.direct_lower_tier_reason: The current session can switch to a cheaper model/effort via /model and /effort.
economy.cost_comparison_note: No paired direct-vs-delegated end-to-end observations exist. Delegation cannot buy a tier-based saving here, but whether its TOTAL cost exceeds DIRECT is unmeasured — switching the session model also invalidates the prompt cache, and a delegate receives a small distilled spec rather than the whole session context.

_probe_sources._codex_live_probe: 2026-09-06: gpt-6-astra·gpt-5.6-sol·gpt-5.6-luna·gpt-5.6-terra 각각 `codex exec --ephemeral --json -s read-only --model <m>` 로 응답 확인. 양성 대조: 존재하지 않는 id 는 provider 400 ('not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account').

_rules.effort_rank_scope: effort_rank orders values ONLY within the same comparison_scope. Never add, subtract, or compare ranks across different comparison_scope values.
_rules.no_auto_to_medium: Never convert 'auto' or 'config' to 'medium' or any concrete level without an observation.
_rules.unsupported_is_null: An unsupported dial is effort_rank=null with effort_semantics='unsupported'.
_rules.observed_wins: If effort_observed or model_observed is present and differs from requested, the observed value is authoritative.
_rules.no_invented_models: Never recommend a model that is not listed in vendor_cli.models for that surface.
_rules.surface_lock: Codex direct recommendations use only codex-cli.recommendation_models. Claude direct recommendations use only claude-code.recommendation_models.
_rules.quality_before_cost: Resolve the minimum sufficient quality floor first. Availability and cost/quota may only break ties among candidates that pass it.
_rules.fable_rollout: Fable 5 is shadow-only for V2 controlled and V3 recommendation-only evaluation. Production eligibility uses V3-only evidence and requires 20 diverse real-task successes, zero failures or partials, an independent verifier, and explicit opt-in.

comparison_requirements: same agent scaffold and tool budget
